name: Web Scrape Monitoring Scorer API
shortDescription: Recommended re-check cadence + volatility band + monitoring-priority score from change rate, importance, and staleness tolerance
description: Agent-native monitoring-cadence scorer computed in pure arithmetic — no fetch, no LLM. /score takes an observed change signal (change_rate_per_day, or mean_change_interval_days, or changes_observed + observation_window_days), a business importance (low/medium/high/critical or 1–10), and an optional staleness tolerance, and returns a recommended re-check interval (sampled below the change interval, capped by tolerance and a 15-minute politeness floor), checks/day, what the cadence is capped by, a volatility band, and a 0–100 monitoring-priority score with a band. The one-call /lookup adds reasoning and monitoring guidance. Deterministic, confidence 1.0.
